info.title: Stringer CleanExtract
info.description: A call is charged only when it returns usable content. The outline is free. Three usable extraction calls are free, total, then USD 0.05 per successful extraction through x402. The allowance does not reset. JSON-LD, Next.js, and Nuxt data can recover text from app shells.

post.summary: Get a free page outline without page text or payment

200.description: Free outline with section ids, byte sizes, total_bytes, fingerprint, and optional fallback_used.

post.summary: Extract a full page or selected sections; charge only for usable content

parameters.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
parameters.description: Base64-encoded x402 v2 payment payload after the three lifetime free extraction calls.

200.description: Usable extraction with clean_markdown and optional fingerprint, sections_returned, sections_missing, output_bounds.sections_dropped, or fallback_used. X-Stringer-Access-Tier identifies a free response; PAYMENT-RESPONSE identifies a settled paid response.

400.description: Missing or invalid input, section ids, or max_output_bytes.

402.description: The lifetime free allowance is exhausted and a USD 0.05 x402 payment is required. Read PAYMENT-REQUIRED.

url_or_html.description: Public HTTP(S) URL or raw HTML.
Public HTTP(S) URL or raw HTML.

sections.description: Ids from a fresh outline; returns only these sections in document order.

max_output_bytes.description: UTF-8 byte ceiling. Whole trailing sections are dropped first and listed in output_bounds.sections_dropped.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 digest of the full extracted Markdown.

UnchargedFailure.description: Uncharged named failure. upstream_timeout returns 504, upstream_http_error returns 502, and bot_challenge, js_shell, empty_extraction, or sections_not_found returns 422. sections_not_found also lists sections_missing and available_sections.
